ANALYSIS_SOURCE_ACCESS: Authorize the comparison sources and retry this job.
STORAGE_PORTABLE_BOOK_ACCESS: Set a password or recovery key for each lab book before exporting its backup.
LAB_BOOK_FOLDER: Choose a folder containing an Observanda lab book.
STORAGE_NAME_MISMATCH: The name must exactly match the folder name, including spaces and spelling.
PROJECT_RELOCATED: This project now uses its own storage. Open the project again to continue.
WORKSPACE_NAME: Enter a valid folder name for this computer, using at most 160 characters and no leading or trailing spaces.
WORKSPACE_NAME_MISMATCH: The workspace name must exactly match its folder name. Choose the parent folder and enter the name you want to create.
STORAGE_DELETING: Deletion of this workspace has started. Open Workspaces to finish removing its data.
STORAGE_DELETE_STATE: The saved deletion no longer matches this folder. Nothing else will be removed. Keep the remaining files for inspection.
STORAGE_DELETE_CONTENTS: This folder also contains files or locations outside this workspace. Move them out before deleting the workspace.
STORAGE_DELETE_BUSY: Finish the workspace conversion, move or unfinished deletion before starting another deletion.
STORAGE_DELETE_SHARED: Another saved folder uses this same older database catalogue. Give that workspace its own database before deleting this one.
STORAGE_DELETE_CONFIRM: Confirm the exact workspace name and folder before permanently deleting it.
TAG_EXISTS: This record already has that tag. Choose a different name or remove the redundant tag.
MEDIA_IN_USE: This image is placed in the record's summary or a writing section. Remove its placement from the text before removing the media.
FIGURE_IN_USE: This figure is placed in the record's summary or a writing section. Remove its placement from the text before removing the figure.
FIGURE_RESULTS: This figure has supporting results. Retarget or remove those results before removing or replacing the figure.
FIGURE_RESULT_COPY: The copy could not retain all supporting results. The original figure has not changed.
FIGURE_COPY_CHANGED: The copied panel's data or axes changed before its supporting results were saved. Copy the source again and save it first; you can then make a separate revision of its measurements.
STORAGE_MOVE_CONTENTS: This folder contains files outside the Observanda workspace. Keep those files in a separate folder before moving, or choose Copy workspace.
STORAGE_MOVE_STATE: The saved workspace move could not be verified. No further source files were removed. Keep the source and destination folders for recovery.
STORAGE_MOVED: This workspace has moved to another folder. Open its verified destination to continue.
NUMERAL_RESULT_INEXACT: A result cannot be written exactly in its selected number format. Choose an exact fraction, a compatible numeral base, or a fractional format for non-integers. No result was rounded or partially retained; earlier datasets remain unchanged.
NUMERAL_RESULT_CAPACITY: The selected result format exceeds the current exact-value storage capacity. No digits were dropped and no partial result was retained. An exact fraction may provide a shorter representation.
EVIDENCE_CORRECTION_INVALID: Review the evidence association, correction reason and replacement fields before continuing.
USER_PROFILE_INVALID: The personal profile is invalid. Check the fields and try again.
USER_PROFILE_CHANGED: Your profile or active identity changed in another session. Reload the profile before saving.
USER_PROFILE_DAMAGED: The saved personal profile could not be opened. It has been preserved without changes.
DATASET_AGGREGATION: Check the grouping columns, numerical input types and unique output names. The aggregation could not be completed; no partial result was retained.
DATASET_AGGREGATION_MISSING: A non-excluded reading is missing. Review the source values or explicitly choose to skip and record missing readings.
DATASET_AGGREGATION_LIMIT: This calculation exceeded exact integer indexing. The result was not committed and no groups were dropped.
DATASET_PACKED_LENGTH: The packed source array is shorter than the declared offset, record width and count require. Check the range in each window; no rows were accepted.
IMPORT_RESEARCH: The selected structured record facts are invalid. Use the supported record-facts format, exact method relationships and explicit source values.
LIVE_UNAVAILABLE: The shared Observanda installation could not be reached securely. Check that it is hosting, that your network or VPN is connected, and that the connection card is current.
COLLABORATION_DEPENDENCY: This selection depends on research outside the granted lab books. Include those books in an explicit access grant before exchanging the complete research chain.
COLLABORATION_PACKAGE: This collaboration file could not be authenticated completely. Check its recipient and verified sender, and obtain the complete original file.
COLLABORATION_SCOPE: The shared project or lab book is no longer available. Review its access settings before preparing another exchange.
COLLABORATION_STRUCTURE: Shared copies return records and evidence. Keep the original project, lab-book names and record-type configuration when preparing changes; ask the owner to update the shared structure.
COLLABORATION_IDENTITY_FILE: The collaboration identity backup could not be verified. Check the backup password and use the complete original file.
COLLABORATION_IDENTITY_PASSWORD: Use a backup password of 12 to 1024 characters and enter it identically in both fields.
COLLABORATION_IDENTITY_CHANGED: The active collaboration identity changed. Review the current fingerprints before trying again.
COLLABORATION_IDENTITY_BUSY: Close other Observanda instances using this installation before changing its collaboration identity.
COLLABORATION_IDENTITY_LOCK: Lock the workspace and stop its shared sessions before changing the collaboration identity.
COLLABORATION_SIGNATURE: This organization command could not be authenticated. Check the sender's verified identity and use the original file.
COLLABORATION_INVALID: Check the organization, member, team and invitation details before submitting again.
COLLABORATION_DAMAGED: Organization administration data failed verification. Restore a verified backup before continuing.
COLLABORATION_DENIED: This identity is not authorized for that organization operation.
COLLABORATION_LAST_ADMIN: Add another administrator before removing or demoting the last administrator.
COLLABORATION_EXPIRED: This command or invitation has expired, has been revoked or has already been used. Request a new invitation if needed.
COLLABORATION_VERIFY: Verify the recipient's complete fingerprint through another channel before inviting them.
COLLABORATION_ALREADY_MEMBER: This invitation has already been accepted or the person is already a member. Manage the existing membership instead.
COLLABORATION_INVITE_REQUIRED: A removed member must accept a new invitation before rejoining.
DATASET_JOIN_LENGTH: Positional alignment requires an acquisition array and a lookup array of exactly the same length in every window. Check for missing arrays, missing entries or extra entries; no rows were accepted.
DATASET_CALCULATION: Check the calculation columns, numeric representations, units and rules. Division by zero, incompatible units and results beyond the exact-value limit stop calculation. Earlier datasets remain unchanged.
DATASET_TABLE: Choose a valid nonempty dataset table selection within the displayed limits.
DATASET_JOIN_KEY: A lookup row has a missing or null key. Choose a scalar key that identifies each control or configuration.
DATASET_JOIN_DUPLICATE: More than one lookup row has the same key in its source group. Use a unique key; Observanda will not choose a match silently.
DATASET_JOIN_MISSING: An acquisition row has no matching lookup key. Check the key paths and exact value types, or explicitly choose to keep unmatched rows with absent values.
GITHUB_ORGANIZATION_AUTH: This organization requires authorization through GitHub. Open Manage authorization on GitHub, authorize the organization, then retry.
GITHUB_RATE_LIMIT: GitHub’s request limit has been reached. Wait for it to reset, then retry. Your saved connection remains available.
GITHUB_PERMISSION: GitHub denied this operation. Check the selected account’s repository access and the organization’s OAuth policy. Pages setup requires administration access.
INTAKE_RECEIPT: This publication receipt does not include the selected record revision. Prepare the intended edition first.
INTAKE_COMPLETION: Save the work before completing it, then link the receipts required by this project's completion policy.
INTAKE_INVALID: The intake proposal is invalid or exceeds its declared limits. Check the version 1 contract in Help.
INTAKE_CHANGED: The intake source or request changed. Validate a new proposal before applying it.
INTAKE_TARGET: This proposal targets a different workspace or record. Select its explicit destination.
INTAKE_NOT_READY: Finish staging and review the proposal before applying it.
ANALYSIS_INVALID: Complete the analysis identity, source mappings, provenance and limitations.
ANALYSIS_MAPPING: An analysis category, boundary or context value does not match its declared mapping. Inspect the retained source and correct the mapping; no result was saved.
ANALYSIS_LIMIT: This comparison exceeds the bounded view or context limit. Narrow the comparison sources or contexts; the original data remains retained.
ANALYSIS_REVIEW: Review changed analysis inputs and record an applicability decision for each affected result before exporting or publishing this edition.
ATTEMPT_IMMUTABLE: Recorded preparations, events and assessments cannot be overwritten or removed. Add an amendment or correction that keeps the earlier facts.
ATTEMPT_CONFLICT: Another preparation or correction was recorded. Review the saved facts before adding your correction.
ATTEMPT_REFERENCE: Choose an exact retained source revision in this workspace, belonging to another record.
DESIGN_PREVIEW_LIMIT: This page exceeds the canvas preview memory limit. Reduce its displayed records or figures and retry. Your saved work is unchanged.
FONT_INVALID: This font could not be read safely. Choose a valid TTF, OTF, WOFF or WOFF2 file up to 8 MiB.
FONT_MISSING: A selected custom font is unavailable. Import it in Appearance or choose another font.
FONT_EMBED: A selected font does not allow website embedding. Check its permission in Appearance or choose another font.
FONT_LIMIT: This workspace already contains 64 custom fonts.
INVENTORY_INVALID: This export has no supported inventory declaration. Check the manifest and reported fields; source files were not changed.
INVENTORY_LIMIT: The source exceeds the declared inventory capacity. No partial inventory is reported as complete.
INVENTORY_CHANGED: The source changed or its pinned identity no longer matches. Inspect a stable source copy again.
INVENTORY_CANCELLED: Source inspection cancelled. No records were imported.
INVENTORY_TIMEOUT: Source inspection timed out. Check the source drive and try again.
REVIEW_INVALID: The review file could not be authenticated. Check its recipient and the verified contact.
WORKSPACE_READ_CURSOR: This saved workspace could not be reopened. Reload the workspace to start a new read.
WORKSPACE_READ_LIMIT: This legacy operation requests the entire workspace and exceeds its capacity. Open the dashboard and select the records you need. Your saved records remain available.
RECORD_SELECTION_LIMIT: This selection exceeds 2 MiB of editable record content. Open fewer records together. Your saved records remain available.
RECORD_QUERY_CURSOR: These results are no longer available. Refresh records to continue.
PUBLICATION_SELECTION_CURSOR: This edition page belongs to a different or expired review. Close the review and choose Review website again. Your saved records and website are unchanged.
RECORD_HISTORY_CURSOR: This history page is no longer available. Refresh the record history to continue.
MODULE_HISTORY_CURSOR: This history page is no longer available. Refresh the item history to continue.
MODULE_QUERY_CURSOR: These items changed while you were browsing. Refresh the list to see the current items; your unfinished edit is kept.
JOB_BUSY: Finish or cancel pending background jobs before preparing a backup. Received originals are kept when processing is cancelled.
JOB_DAMAGED: This background task could not be verified. Its original files were kept. Restore a verified backup before continuing.
JOB_UNSUPPORTED: This task needs an unavailable application module. Its original files were kept.
JOB_CHANGED: This task has changed. Refresh its progress before trying again.
JOB_CAPACITY: The background queue is full. Finish or cancel pending tasks before adding more.
JOB_LEASE: This worker no longer owns the task. Its original files were kept for recovery.
JOB_RELOCATED: This task now belongs to the project in its new location.
PROJECT_JOB_ACTIVE: A publishing task is still running for this project. Let it finish before moving the project database.
JOB_CANCELLED: Processing was cancelled. Received original bytes were kept for retry.
DATABASE_LOCATION: The database directory does not match its owner. Workspace database files must stay inside that workspace; application preferences and PostgreSQL executables must be stored separately.
DATABASE_LOCK_TOOLS: The macOS system Perl tool is required to protect managed database ownership. Restore /usr/bin/perl or configure an externally managed PostgreSQL database.
DATABASE_PERMISSION: The Observanda database account needs CREATE and TEMPORARY permissions in its dedicated PostgreSQL database. It does not need superuser privileges.
DATABASE_CANCELLED: PostgreSQL setup was cancelled. Restart Observanda to resume setup; existing workspaces were preserved.
DATABASE_BUSY: This database is handling its maximum concurrent workload. Please retry shortly.
DATABASE_INSTALL: PostgreSQL setup could not finish. Check the connection and available disk space, then restart Observanda to retry.
DATABASE_TOOLS: PostgreSQL tools are unavailable. Install PostgreSQL 16, 17 or 18 using your system package manager, or set OBSERVANDA_POSTGRES_BIN to its bin folder.
DATABASE_RUNNING: Another Observanda process is managing this database. Close that process before starting this installation again.
DATABASE_RUNTIME: The managed PostgreSQL configuration or version could not be verified. Existing database files were preserved.
DATABASE_WORKSPACE_RUNNING: This workspace database was opened by another installation. Close it there before opening this copy. No database process was stopped.
DATABASE_UPDATE: This PostgreSQL runtime has a different major version from your existing database. Reopen it with a compatible Observanda installation. Changing database engine versions requires a supported update; your database has not been replaced.
SERVER_CLOSING: Observanda is shutting down. Let the current saves finish, then reopen the application.
DATABASE_CONFIG: PostgreSQL is not configured. Set OBSERVANDA_DATABASE_URL for the Observanda service, then restart it.
DATABASE_TLS: Remote PostgreSQL connections require certificate-verified TLS. Set OBSERVANDA_DATABASE_TLS=verify-full and, for a private authority, OBSERVANDA_DATABASE_CA.
DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE: PostgreSQL is unavailable. Check the database service and its connection settings, then retry. Your saved data has not been replaced.
CATALOGUE_DAMAGED: The research catalogue could not be verified. Its files have been preserved. Restore a verified copy before continuing.
RECORD_VIEW_FORMAT: Saved record views could not be read. Their file has been preserved; restore it from a verified backup.
RECORD_VIEW_CHANGED: This saved view changed in another window. Your form is still here. Reopen Saved views to review the latest version before updating it.
RECORD_VIEW_NAME: A view with this name already exists. Choose a different name.
RECORD_VIEW_SCOPE: The selected project or lab book is no longer available. Choose another scope before saving.
RECORD_HISTORY_MISSING: This record revision is unavailable or changed. Reopen its history before trying again.
MATERIAL_DUPLICATE: This exact revision is already selected. Each input or output can appear once in a collection or analysis.
MATERIAL_DRAFT_INCOMPLETE: Some selected references have not been received. Resume this draft before completing it.
MATERIAL_DATASET_LIMIT: This dataset exceeds the supported exact index range. Its original and earlier revisions are unchanged.
MATERIAL_ANALYSIS_LIMIT: This figure exceeds 10,000 output points, 256 series, 262,144 label characters or the median sorting capacity. Summarize rows or choose fewer series. Nothing was truncated; originals and previous results are unchanged.
MATERIAL_PLOT_LIMIT: This request exceeds the small-table reader budget. Read retained pages instead. Original values and revisions are unchanged.
MATERIAL_TABLE: Check the UTF-8 source and mapping: use consistent delimited columns, a JSON array, or one JSON value per line. Limits: 256 columns, 262,144 characters per row, 64 nesting levels and 4,096 keys per object. The original file has been kept.
MATERIAL_INVALID: Check the evidence or dataset fields. Nothing was replaced.
MATERIAL_REFERENCE_LIMIT: This direct request contains more than 64 references. Use the paged collection or analysis workflow to save the complete selection.
MATERIAL_CHANGED: This material has a newer revision. Reopen it before saving changes.
MATERIAL_MISSING: The retained revision is unavailable. Restore it from a verified workspace backup.
MATERIAL_SOURCE_CHANGED: The selected file differs from the saved original. Received originals were kept; select the original file to resume.
MATERIAL_INCOMPLETE: This import is incomplete. Select the same original file to resume it.
MATERIAL_PRECISION: This column cannot be plotted with the selected numeric policy. Keep it as a label, explicitly allow approximate coordinates, or retain a separately identified conversion. Nonfinite coordinates and nonzero values that underflow to zero are rejected.
MEASUREMENT_INVALID: Check measurement values, provenance and locators. Raw instrument codes must be unitless, and external time transformations need pinned model and reference data. Byte ranges and dataset cells must exist in their retained sources.
CALENDAR_URL: Use an HTTPS subscription on a public calendar host. Local network addresses and redirects to them are not accepted.
CALENDAR_FETCH: This calendar could not be refreshed. Check its subscription URL and connection, then retry.
CALENDAR_FORMAT: This feed could not be read as an iCalendar calendar. Check its calendar URL and time zones.
CALENDAR_LIMIT: This calendar exceeds the download or recurrence limit. Use a smaller date range or a more focused subscription.
CALENDAR_LOCKED: Unlock this connected workspace to include its calendars for this session.
CALENDAR_SELF: This is the current workspace. Its calendars are already included.
CALENDAR_CURSOR: The calendar or its sources changed. Refresh the schedule to continue from the first page.
DEVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Secure device storage is unavailable. Use a workspace password or recovery key to unlock, or choose password encryption for a new workspace.
DEVICE_UNKNOWN: This device has not been granted access. Use a workspace password or recovery key, or ask a member to authorize this device.
DEVICE_INVALID: The device key or access request is invalid. The stored keys have not been replaced.
ACCESS_UPGRADE: Create a new encrypted copy to enable device sharing and recovery for this older workspace.
ACCESS_CONFIRM: Verify the recipient fingerprint and confirm access to this entire workspace.
MODULE_INVALID: Check the highlighted module fields. Your changes have not been saved.
MODULE_FORMAT: Module data uses an unsupported or damaged format. The stored file has not been changed.
MODULE_CHANGED: This item changed in another window. Your draft is retained. Compare it with the latest saved version before saving again.
MODULE_REFERENCE: A linked item or category changed. Refresh the available choices before continuing.
MODULE_REPLAY: This save identifier was already used for different data. Refresh before attempting another operation.
STOCK_UNAVAILABLE: There is not enough available stock, or this material is held or retired. No stock movement was recorded.
TASK_BLOCKED: Complete this task's checklist and prerequisites first. A completed dependent task also prevents reopening its prerequisite.
BOOKING_CONFLICT: The requested period exceeds equipment capacity or overlaps maintenance. Choose another time.
BOOKING_UNAVAILABLE: This equipment is held or retired and cannot accept bookings.
DRAFT_CURSOR: This draft page is no longer available. Refresh the recovery list to continue.
DRAFT_CHANGED: This recovery draft changed in another window. Refresh the draft list before choosing what to keep.
RECORD_CHANGED: This record changed in another window. Your edits are still on screen; the stored version has not been replaced.
PUBLICATION_EMPTY: Select content or add a homepage introduction before reviewing the website.
DASHBOARD_CHANGED: Dashboard settings changed in another tab. Your draft is kept. Discard it to load the saved version, or keep it open for comparison.
FOLDER_PICKER_UNAVAILABLE: The system folder picker is unavailable on the computer running Observanda.
FOLDER_PICKER_FAILED: The system folder picker could not open. Retry or enter a folder path.
FOLDER_PICKER_BUSY: A folder picker is already open. Finish or cancel that selection first.
FOLDER_PICKER_TIMEOUT: Folder selection timed out. Open the picker again to continue.
PREFERENCES_FORMAT: The app preferences file is not valid. Its contents have been preserved.
PREFERENCES_CHANGED: App preferences changed after this reset was opened. Reopen the reset dialog to review the current settings.
FOLDER_TIMEOUT: This folder took too long to respond. Check the drive or network connection, then try again or choose another folder.
FOLDER_UNAVAILABLE: This folder is unavailable. Check that it exists and that you have access, or choose another folder.
FOLDER_BUSY: Several folders are already loading. Wait for one to finish, then try again.
FOLDER_NAME: Enter a folder name without slashes, reserved names or trailing dots.
FOLDER_EXISTS: A folder or file with that name already exists. Choose another name.
ENCRYPTION_DAMAGED: Encrypted content could not be authenticated. The file may be damaged or replaced. Restore a verified backup; no changes were saved.
ENCRYPT_COPY: Create an encrypted copy in a new folder to protect this existing workspace. The original is retained until you decide what to do with it.
ENCRYPT_PASSWORD: An encrypted workspace requires a password. Enter a new password to change it.
STORAGE_PATH: Choose an absolute path to a dedicated workspace folder. Its parent must already exist. Mount or connect network shares through your operating system first.
STORAGE_INCOMPLETE: This folder contains an incomplete workspace creation or copy. Choose another destination, or open the original when copying.
STORAGE_COPY: Workspace copy verification failed. The original workspace is unchanged; the incomplete destination has not been opened.
STORAGE_PORTABLE_PROJECT_ACCESS: Set a password or recovery key for this project before exporting it for another computer.
STORAGE_PORTABLE_ACCESS: Enter the workspace password or recovery key to verify access on another computer. If you use only device unlock, configure a password or recovery key in Storage & access first.
STORAGE_LINKED_COPY: Another remembered folder still uses this research database. To create an independent workspace, use Copy workspace or Create portable workspace copy from the original folder. For a move, close Observanda and move the entire original folder instead of duplicating it.
CATALOGUE_UNAVAILABLE: This folder refers to a research database that is unavailable on this installation. On the original computer, use Create portable workspace copy in Storage & access, then open that complete copy here.
STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: The saved workspace location is unavailable. Reconnect its drive or network share, or choose an existing workspace. No replacement has been created.
WORKSPACE_CHANGED: The active workspace changed in another tab. Reload this tab before continuing; keep a copy of any unsaved draft first.
ACCESS_INVALID: Use a username up to 80 characters and a password of 12 to 1024 characters, or leave it blank to use secure device access.
ACCESS_FORMAT: The workspace access settings are unreadable. Restore them from a backup; access has not been bypassed.
ACCESS_DENIED: The supplied credentials are incorrect or no longer grant access.
ACCESS_WAIT: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
PUBLISH_PENDING: Resolve the earlier deployment in Publishing before starting another upload to this destination. Its push may have succeeded even if the response was interrupted.
PUBLISH_EMPTY_REPO: This GitHub repository is empty. Open Configure destination and use Check connection to review and initialize its website branch.
PUBLISH_REPO_EXISTS: A repository with this name already exists. Choose Use an existing repository to review it, or choose another name. No existing files were changed.
PUBLISH_PAGES: The GitHub Pages source changed. Review the destination again before configuring it for this website.
PUBLISH_POLICY: This release exceeds the file or site size configured for this publishing destination.
PUBLISH_SIZE: This release exceeds GitHub hosting limits (100 MiB per file or 1 GB per site). Choose another host or reduce the published selection.
PUBLISH_NOT_LIVE: The uploaded release is not verified at the public URL yet. Check deployment status and the configured URL, then retry.
LAB_INVALID: Check the sample or analysis fields. Codes must be unique, dates valid, and numeric results must have units.
LAB_STALE: Laboratory records changed in another view. Reload Laboratory before continuing.
LAB_TRANSITION: This action is not available for the current result status. Reviewed results require an amendment before editing.
PUBLISH_CONFIG: Check the destination fields. For a GitHub folder, use names separated by /, such as lab/field-notes. SSH requires a dedicated hosting directory.
PUBLISH_AUTH: Connect GitHub in Preferences → Integrations. Your account needs permission to update the selected repository and manage Pages when configuring a website.
GITHUB_HELPER_MISSING: Browser sign-in is unavailable in this installation. Install or repair the current Observanda package, which includes its GitHub connection tools.
GITHUB_CREDENTIALS: The local credential manager could not complete the operation. Check your operating-system credential store and try signing in again.
GITHUB_CONNECTION_DAMAGED: The local GitHub account settings could not be read. Your workspace and GitHub repositories have not been changed.
GITHUB_RECONNECT: GitHub authorization is unavailable or has been revoked. Sign in again in Preferences → Integrations; your destination and prepared website are retained.
GITHUB_SIGNIN_CANCELLED: GitHub sign-in was cancelled. You can close the authorization tab in your browser.
GITHUB_SIGNIN_TIMEOUT: GitHub sign-in timed out. Try again and complete authorization in your browser within three minutes.
GITHUB_SIGNIN_BUSY: Finish or cancel the current GitHub sign-in before changing accounts or publishing.
GITHUB_PUBLICATION_BUSY: Finish or stop the current repository setup or upload before changing the GitHub connection.
GITHUB_BROWSER_UNAVAILABLE: Browser sign-in requires Observanda to run in your local desktop session.
PUBLISH_REMOTE: The destination could not be verified. Check access, destination settings, and connection. No successful publication is confirmed.
PUBLISH_TREE_INCOMPLETE: GitHub returned an incomplete directory listing, even when requested separately. Observanda cannot verify all repository files. Retry verification or use another publishing destination; this operation has not confirmed publication.
PUBLISH_PLAN_CAPACITY: The repository review exceeds the current saved-review capacity. Your prepared edition remains available and no repository changes were made. Keep the edition for retry after a capacity update, or select another publishing destination.
PUBLISH_OWNERSHIP: The destination has changes outside this publisher. Review the repository changes before uploading, or select a dedicated hosting directory.
PUBLISH_STALE: The destination or release changed. Check the destination and review the release again.
PUBLISH_SSH: SSH publishing failed. Check OpenSSH tools, key or agent authentication, known host verification, and the hosting directory. The server must support a POSIX shell, find, sha256sum, and GNU coreutils.
STORAGE_FULL: The storage volume has insufficient free space for this operation or its configured free-space reserve.
SVG_EXTERNAL: This SVG references external content or entities. Embed its images and styles, then upload the self-contained file.
SVG_STATIC: Use a static SVG without scripts, animation or embedded HTML. Export a still copy from your drawing application.
SVG_LIMIT: This SVG exceeds the renderer capacity (32 MiB source, 64 million pixels or document complexity). Reduce its canvas or simplify the drawing.
MEDIA_TOOL: Media processing requires FFmpeg and ffprobe on this computer. Install FFmpeg, then restart Observanda.
MEDIA_INVALID: This media file could not be prepared. Choose a supported still image, audio recording, or video. Your source file is unchanged.
MEDIA_LIMIT: This file exceeds a media limit configured in Storage & access.
INVALID: Some fields are invalid. Check the highlighted record and try again.
FORMAT: This workspace uses an unsupported or damaged format. The source has not been changed.
MISSING: No workspace exists here yet. Create one to begin.
EXISTS: A workspace or output already exists here. Choose a new destination.
CONFLICT: This workspace changed since you opened it. Reload before saving; your draft has been kept on screen.
LOCKED: Another operation is currently using this writer.
LEGACY_WRITE_LOCK: An older installation left a writer marker. Open Storage & access to review recovery after closing other installations that use this location.
DASHBOARD_PENDING: Save or discard pending module and dashboard changes before deleting this workspace. Open Preferences > Modules to review them.
WRITE_CANCELLED: The pending write was cancelled before it started.
UNSAFE: A protected file location is unsafe. No files were changed.
PRIVACY: Export blocked: selected content contains a local path or potentially private information. Edit or deselect the affected item.
EMPTY: Include at least one project in Website before building your site.
AUTH: This browser session is not authorized. Reopen the launch link printed by Observanda.
ORIGIN: This request did not come from the local Observanda application.
LIMIT: This request exceeds the first releaseÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â€žÂ¢s size limit.
STALE: The workspace changed after preview. Create a new preview before exporting.
NOT_FOUND: This item is unavailable. Create a new preview if needed.
IO: The operation could not be completed. Check access and available disk space; your existing workspace is preserved.
LOCAL_EXPORT_CHANGED: The destination changed or contains files this export does not own. No conflicting file was replaced. Review the listed paths, restore the expected files or choose another folder.
LOCAL_EXPORT_DAMAGED: The local export receipt is damaged. Keep the destination files and restore the workspace from a verified backup.
LOCAL_EXPORT_REVIEW: Review the edition and the proposed file changes, then confirm the local export.
LOCAL_EXPORT_RECOVER: This export has already started changing files. Resume it to finish the reviewed edition.
RECORD_SIZE_LIMIT: This record exceeds the authored-content capacity of this version. Your saved revision is unchanged. Keep the editor open and check the checkpoint status before leaving.
WORKSPACE_METADATA_LIMIT: These workspace settings exceed the capacity of this version. Saved records and settings are unchanged. Keep the editor open to retain unsaved changes.
RECORD_COMMAND_LIMIT: This record save request exceeds the capacity of this version. Keep the editor open and check the checkpoint status before leaving.
DRAFT_SIZE_LIMIT: This recovery checkpoint exceeds the capacity of this version. Any earlier checkpoint is unchanged. Keep the editor open to retain the newer edits.
IMPORT_CONTENT: This selection cannot be imported as the chosen editable content. Check its format and boundary. Text fields accept up to 60,000 characters; retain large data as originals and map a smaller writing selection.
IMPORT_MAPPING: Review the destination, content, date and relationship mappings before continuing.
IMPORT_DATE: This source date cannot be used as an occurrence date without interpretation. Choose Unknown; the original value and its meaning remain in source provenance.
IMPORT_DAMAGED: An import receipt or retained original failed verification. Keep the workspace and recover from a verified backup.
IMPORT_CHANGED: An import target or review changed. Review the batch again before applying it; saved records have not been replaced.
IMPORT_REVIEW: Finish and review the import plan before applying or reversing this batch.
IMPORT_DEPENDENCY: A mapped relationship has no available destination. Import its target or explicitly omit the relationship with a reason.
IMPORT_CURRENT: Choose exactly one current revision for each imported source identity. Other revisions remain available as exact historical references.
IMPORT_CYCLE: Exact revision links form a cycle. Choose a current-record link for an appropriate relationship, or omit it with an explicit reason, then review again.
IMPORT_CONVERSION: The text conversion omits source elements. Review the omission list and explicitly accept it, or choose another content mapping. Original bytes remain available.
IMPORT_COLLISION: This destination record exists without an importer ownership receipt. It cannot be overwritten by this import.
IMPORT_SOURCE: Choose an external source export outside this workspace.
IMPORT_INCOMPLETE: Resolve the source inventory discrepancies before staging an import. Exclusions must have explicit reasons.
IMPORT_ROWS: The imported dataset row count differs from the source declaration. Resolve the discrepancy before applying the import.
IMPORT_EXCLUDED_BOUNDARY: This editable selection overlaps an excluded source object. Use a separate declared boundary before importing; excluded history cannot be folded into another record.
IMPORT_FIGURE: This selection is not a supported portable figure definition. Preserve the original and choose an explicit content mapping; arbitrary chart HTML or images cannot silently become editable measurements.
PUBLISH_CONFLICT: Publishing is blocked because these paths contain other files or a previously published file was changed or removed outside Observanda. Restore the expected published files or choose another website folder, then prepare and review the destination again.
PUBLICATION_LINKS: Legacy website links are ambiguous, unavailable in this edition, or collide with a generated page. Review the paths and fragment mappings in Publishing before preparing again.
STARTER_INVALID: Check the template fields. Replace workspace links, placed figures and custom fonts with independent instructions before saving.
STARTER_CHANGED: This template changed in another window. Your unsaved form is still here. Reopen the template to review the current version.
STARTER_ARCHIVED: Restore this archived template before editing it or creating another record from it.
STARTER_PASSWORD: Use a template package password between 12 and 1024 characters.
STARTER_PACKAGE: The template package could not be opened. Check its password and file integrity. No template was imported.
RESOURCE_TAGS: Use up to 24 distinct resource tags, each from 1 to 80 characters, without commas or control characters. Tag filters apply to inventory items.
PROJECT_FOLDER: Choose a folder containing a dedicated Observanda project.
PROJECT_LOCATION_EXISTS: This project is already registered at another folder. Open it from Projects or use Move project to change its location.
STORAGE_PROJECT_BUSY: Finish this project’s pending copy, move or deletion before starting another storage operation.
PROJECT_MIGRATION_OWNERSHIP: This project has historical content with missing or conflicting ownership. Resolve those owners before moving it into a dedicated database.
PROJECT_MIGRATION_FORMAT: This project has older history that needs an explicit ownership conversion before it can be separated.
PROJECT_MOVED: This project has moved to another workspace. Open that workspace to use it.
PROJECT_DELETED: This project was deleted. Restore its backup to open its records again.
PROJECT_MIGRATION_DEPENDENCY: This project refers to evidence owned by another project. Its linked evidence must have a verified project owner before migration can finish.
PROJECT_MIGRATION_DRAFT_INCOMPLETE: Finish the pending record draft upload before separating this project. Its project ownership is not yet available.
WORKSPACE_NAME_EXISTS: Another registered workspace already uses this folder name. Choose a different name.
STORAGE_RENAMING: This workspace is being renamed. Reopen it to resume the rename.
STORAGE_RENAME_STATE: The workspace rename could not be reconciled with its saved folder identities.
STORAGE_RENAME_BUSY: Finish the current workspace storage operation before renaming this folder.
STORAGE_RENAME_PROJECTS: This workspace contains project folders that need relocation before it can be renamed.
LAB_BOOK_TRANSFER_PENDING: Resume or cancel the pending lab-book transfer before changing its location.
LAB_BOOK_MOVE_PENDING: A lab-book move needs to finish before changing this folder.
LAB_BOOK_MOVED: This lab book belongs to another project. Open it from its current project.
STORAGE_RENAME_VOLUME: The filesystem cannot move this lab book between these project folders.
LAB_BOOK_IMPORT_PENDING: Finish importing this lab book before changing its storage.
LAB_BOOK_IMPORT_ACCESS: The lab book could not be unlocked. Check its password or recovery key.
PROJECT_IMPORT_ACCESS: Unlock the selected project or lab book to continue importing.
PUBLICATION_IDENTITY: The selected sources contain conflicting publication identities.
PROJECT_MOVE_DESTINATION_ACCESS: Unlock the destination workspace to continue this move.
